title: uuidna — content-addressed identity, honest by construction
description: A content-addressed identity system, honest by construction: a Lean 4 theorem ledger (every theorem proven by decide, sorry-free, no Mathlib, folded to one order-invariant receipt), holographic merkle proofs, a reversible imprint codec, a reeducating honesty gate, a measured billing model, pure-TypeScript ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption under a 7-dimensional fold envelope, and an MCP server. A content-address proves integrity, not truth. Deposited metadata fingerprints the release; the proofs recompute from the source with `npm run lean`.
